verdict.rationale: Zero is an open-source email app with an MCP surface, so an interactive API reference is a fair question for it. The evidence shows no such reference exists: there is no public HTTP API, MCP.md is only a prose capability list with no endpoint schema, and no docs site resolves. Nothing documents explorable or runnable API examples.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
